panels.description: Share of course-logged recommendation requests that received status 200, per completed five-minute bucket and over a rolling 24 hours. Unlike successful-request volume, the course log also records timeouts and failures that never reached the API. Null for buckets with no logged requests. An alert fires when three consecutive buckets are each below 70%.

targets.rawSql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT window_end AS time, availability_request_count::double precision AS total, availability_success_count::double precision AS succeeded FROM monitoring_runs WHERE window_end >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND window_end <= CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes'), series AS (SELECT time, total, succeeded, SUM(total) OVER (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '23 hours 55 minutes' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_total, SUM(succeeded) OVER (ORDER BY time RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '23 hours 55 minutes' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_succeeded FROM buckets) SELECT time, CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE succeeded / total END AS "5-minute availability", CASE WHEN rolling_total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE rolling_succeeded / rolling_total END AS "Rolling 24-hour availability" FROM series WHERE time >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Availability: 5-Minute and Rolling 24-Hour

panels.description: Course-logged requests per completed five-minute bucket that did not succeed. No response is course status 0 (timeout or connection failure); other failures are any other non-200 or unrecognized status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, availability_no_response_count::double precision AS "No response (status 0)", availability_other_failure_count::double precision AS "Other failures" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Failed Requests

panels.description: Successful recommendation requests per completed five-minute bucket. Three consecutive zero buckets trigger a traffic-stopped alert; missing monitoring data is handled separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, request_count::double precision AS "Successful requests" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Successful Request Volume

panels.description: Successful requests whose turnaround time was strictly greater than 600 ms.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, request_count_over_600ms::double precision AS "Requests over 600 ms" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Slow Request Count

panels.description: Null for completed buckets with no successful requests. An alert fires when an eligible bucket remains above 5% for 10 minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_end AS time, CASE WHEN request_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE request_count_over_600ms::double precision / request_count END AS "Share over 600 ms" FROM monitoring_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(window_end) AND window_end = window_start + INTERVAL '5 minutes' ORDER BY window_end

panels.title: Slow Request Share

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(generated_at)))::double precision AS "Seconds since success" FROM monitoring_runs
